topic: external benchmarks and comparison sources for security/OS products - how to select, cite, and bound claims against third-party benchmarks and market data

subtopics.scope: Classifying third-party sources into source classes (primary/official, commercial market-research vendor, aggregator, press, forum) and what each class can honestly support.
seed_queries: primary source versus market research report credibility citing security benchmarks
technology market sizing methodology market research vendors credibility

subtopics.scope: Breach-cost benchmarks such as the IBM Cost of a Data Breach report and how a directional cost-of-status-quo number differs from a customer-specific savings claim.
seed_queries: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025 phishing initial attack vector average cost
average cost data breach phishing credential compromise industry report

subtopics.scope: Commercial market-research estimates for the FIDO2 hardware security key market: how vendor-to-vendor variance forces range framing instead of single figures.
seed_queries: FIDO2 hardware security key market size 2025 2034 forecast CAGR
hardware authentication token market research estimates comparison vendors

subtopics.scope: Live, checkable vendor retail pricing (YubiKey 5 Series) as the strongest class of hardware-cost benchmark and its refresh discipline.
seed_queries: YubiKey 5 series official price store NFC 5Ci
hardware security key retail price YubiKey Nitrokey comparison

subtopics.scope: Government and standards-body guidance (NIST SP 800-63B, CISA, OMB M-22-09) as citation sources for phishing-resistant MFA and what such citations cannot imply.
seed_queries: NIST SP 800-63B phishing resistant authenticator verifier impersonation resistance
CISA OMB memorandum phishing resistant MFA federal agencies FIDO2 gold standard

subtopics.scope: Drawing explicit use-for and do-not-use-for boundaries on each benchmark so directional third-party data is never read as product evidence.
seed_queries: misuse of third party benchmark claims in product marketing boundaries
avoid overclaiming product benefits external market data citation discipline

subtopics.scope: Refresh cadence and staleness management for cited external sources: annual reports, live retail prices, and periodically revised government guidance.
seed_queries: citation staleness refresh cadence market data annual reports
documenting retrieval dates sources freshness policy documentation

subtopics.scope: Reconciling conflicting numbers between internal worksheets and external benchmarks (the stale hardware-cost floor problem) without silently overwriting either.
seed_queries: reconciling conflicting statistics between business documents process
conflicting market estimates ranges reconcile numbers citation

subtopics.scope: Building the reusable citation and benchmark table plus dependency map that lets future business docs cite instead of inventing numbers.
seed_queries: reusable citation benchmark table documentation practice marketing claims
source provenance tracking product marketing claims approved sources list
